subject: POC alignment: success gates, runbook assignments, and mid-trial checkpoint
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Hutchinson <laura@hutchinson.ai>, Tom Reyes <tom@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: POC alignment: success gates, runbook assignments, and mid-trial checkpoint

Hi Laura / Tom —

Great to meet today. Quick follow-up from our discovery so we have a tight POC plan to run next month. I pulled this together based on our call and the examples you shared. Main goal: validate Redwood can reduce 95th-percentile inference latency for your triage workflow while keeping semantic fidelity above your current baseline.

Proposed success gates (draft)
- Latency: 95th percentile token latency <= 120ms for 1-2k concurrent low-burst requests (simulated prod mix).
- Cost: per-token inference cost at or below $0.002 with batching + cache profile applied.
- Quality: Rouge-L / task pass rate >= your current baseline on the 150-case evaluation set you provided.
- Integration: API contract validation — two endpoints (summary + classification) live in staging and pass smoke tests.

Owners & runbook items
- EdgeHealth smoke tests + evaluation set: Laura (provide dataset & acceptance script by 2026-11-27).
- Redwood staging deployment + model tuning: Ben (deploy model variant + quantization profile by 2026-12-01).
- End-to-end integration & client validation: Marissa (coordinate SDK snippet and webhook delivery test).

Timeline (proposed)
- Week 0 (now): align on targets & freeze dataset
- Week 1 (11/30): staging deploy + smoke tests run
- Week 2 (12/07): run evaluation suite, tune batching/cache profiles
- Week 3 (12/14): joint validation, final report + decision

Attachments: I attached a one-page runbook and a blank evaluation template to make it easy to capture metrics.

Next steps
1) Laura: confirm acceptance criteria above + share the 150-case eval set by EOD 11/27
2) Ben: stand up staging model + share endpoint & sample keys by 12/01
3) Marissa: prepare integration checklist and test webhook example by 12/01

If that all looks good I’ll schedule a 15-min mid-trial checkpoint for 12/08 to review results and blockers.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni | Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment stubs: edgehealth-poc-runbook-v1.pdf (1 page); evaluation-metrics-template.xlsx (xlsx stub)

From: Laura Hutchinson <laura@hutchinson.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom@edgehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success gates, runbook assignments, and mid-trial checkpoint

Vivek —

Thanks for the crisp note. This matches our internal priorities. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- Quality metric: rather than Rouge-L we prefer a task pass/fail rate measured against our clinician rubric (PASS if summary includes diagnosis and recommended next step). We can map that into the Excel template.
- Latency targets: 120ms 95th for the first pass is reasonable; can we also capture median and p99 for context?
- Data: I’ll upload the 150-case eval set to your Drive folder by EOD Friday (11/27). Expect a CSV plus a short rubric.

One ask: we need to confirm data handling — will the trial data be kept for debugging only and deleted after 90 days? Also, sharing a SOC2 summary and data retention addendum would help our security & procurement review.

Tom & I are available for the mid-trial checkpoint on 12/08 at 10am PT if that works.

Laura Hutchinson
Head of Clinical Ops, EdgeHealth
laura@hutchinson.ai

On Tue, 24 Nov 2026 at 11:08 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> [original message omitted for brevity]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success gates, runbook assignments, and mid-trial checkpoint

Looping you both in with a quick status update from infra/dev side:

- Staging model image: built and pushed to the registry (tag: edgehealth-staging-v1). I’ve enabled the latency-optimized kernel and a 4-bit quantization profile as a starting point.
- Endpoints: /v1/summarize and /v1/classify are up on the staging cluster. I placed sample keys in the Drive creds file (link in the runbook).
- Smoke tests: ran a quick synthetic pass — median token latency ~45ms, 95th ~130ms on a simulated 1k concurrent profile. We expect tuning (batching & cache) to bring 95th down to target.

Blocking items for the week:
1) Need the evaluation CSV + rubric from Laura (per Vivek request) to run the actual quality pass.
2) Marissa — can you post the integration checklist and a short SDK example (node/python) so EdgeHealth can exercise the webhook flow?

I’ll schedule the initial evaluation run on 12/02 once we have the dataset.

Ben
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment stub: infra-deploy-notes.txt

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Hutchinson <laura@hutchinson.ai>, Tom Reyes <tom@edgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC alignment: success gates, runbook assignments, and mid-trial checkpoint

Quick mid-week nudge —

Thanks Laura for confirming the rubric and for agreeing to the 12/08 checkpoint. Two small asks so we keep momentum:

1) Laura: can you drop the eval CSV in the Drive folder by EOD today (11/30)? Ben is queued to run the scheduled evaluation tomorrow (12/02) and we want to use your rubric.
2) Marissa: can you paste a one-line webhook test in the Drive runbook (or reply inline) so EdgeHealth can validate the integration without waiting for SDK work?

If both items land today we’ll run the quality pass against your actual cases tomorrow and share a short findings note by 12/03. Otherwise we’ll shift that to 12/04.

Small logistics note: we attached a short SOC2 summary and a standard data handling addendum to the Drive folder (redwood-data-addendum.pdf) — Laura, please let us know if your procurement needs any edits.

Thanks,
Vivek

Reminder: mid-trial checkpoint scheduled 2026-12-08 10:00 PT (15 mins).
